teaser: A closed door, and you are the one who closes it. Life path 7 asks for solitude thick enough to think inside; ISFP moves through a day on feeling and texture more than analysis. Crossed together, the two make an unusual pair: an inward eye built for pattern meets a self built for sensation, and the question becomes whether a quiet mind can also stay a soft one. An evening alone gets spent untangling something that happened at dinner, long after everyone else has stopped thinking about it, the feeling still turning over even once the thought behind it has gone still.
